# Practice EHR

> A comprehensive cloud-based EHR platform with AI-powered solutions for medical practices, combining electronic health records, practice management, and revenue cycle management.

Practice EHR delivers an all-in-one healthcare software suite designed to streamline clinical workflows, automate administrative tasks, and optimize billing operations. The platform integrates AI technologies including AI Scribe, AI Scanner, AI Agents, and AI Claim Editor to enhance documentation, reduce manual work, and improve operational efficiency across medical practices of all specialties.

## Key Topics

- AI Scribe
- AI Scanner
- AI Agents
- AI Claim Editor
- Electronic Health Records (EHR)
- Practice Management
- Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
- Patient Portal
- Telehealth/Televisit
- Medical Billing Automation
- Clinical Documentation
- HIPAA Compliance
- Scheduling
- Healthcare Automation
- Specialty-Specific Solutions

## Core EHR & Clinical Solutions

- [Electronic Health Records (EHR)](https://www.practiceehr.com/product/electronic-health-records): Core EHR solution with AI-powered features for medical practices
- [AI Solutions Overview](https://www.practiceehr.com/ai-solutions): Overview of AI solutions: Scanner, Scribe, Agents, Claim Editor
- [AI Scribe](https://www.practiceehr.com/ai-solutions/ai-scribe): AI Scribe converts conversations to precise medical documentation
- [AI Agents](https://www.practiceehr.com/ai-solutions/ai-agents): AI Agents automate routine healthcare workflows and documentation
- [Clinical Efficiency](https://www.practiceehr.com/solutions/clinical-efficiency): Clinical efficiency tools with AI Scribe for documentation
- [Televisit - Telehealth Solutions](https://www.practiceehr.com/product/televisit): HIPAA-compliant telehealth solution with AI Scribe integration

## Practice Management & Operations

- [Practice Management Software](https://www.practiceehr.com/product/practice-management): Practice management software with billing and claims automation
- [Patient Management](https://www.practiceehr.com/solutions/patient-management): Patient management solution covering scheduling, charting, intake
- [Operational Efficiency](https://www.practiceehr.com/solutions/operational-efficiency): Operational efficiency features for workflow optimization
- [Patient Check-in Kiosk](https://www.practiceehr.com/product/patient-check-in-kiosk): Self-serve patient check-in kiosk with AI Scanner automation
- [PracticeEHR GO Mobile App](https://www.practiceehr.com/product/practiceehr-go-app): Mobile EHR app for scheduling, notes, and patient messages

## Revenue Cycle Management & Billing

- [Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)](https://www.practiceehr.com/product/revenue-cycle-management): RCM services with AI Claim Editor for medical billing automation
- [Billing and Payments](https://www.practiceehr.com/solutions/billing-and-payments): Billing solution with claims, payment posting, denial management

## Patient Engagement & Communication

- [Patient Portal](https://www.practiceehr.com/product/patient-portal): HIPAA-compliant patient portal for appointments, refills, payments
